title: Pancreatic elastase in stool
what: This stool test checks for an enzyme from the pancreas. It shows whether you have enough enzymes to digest food.
why: For greasy, bulky stools that are hard to flush, weight loss, and bloating, for pancreas conditions, and in children, for poor weight gain.
duration: collection at home takes a few minutes; results usually come in a few days
tell_doctor: If your stool is watery right now. The result may be less accurate
If you take enzyme pills or other medicines
If you had surgery on the stomach, bowel, or pancreas

prepare.title: Container
prepare.text: Get a container with a small spoon from a pharmacy or the lab.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop anything on your own. Enzyme pills usually do not affect this test, but tell your doctor about them.

prepare.title: Stool
prepare.text: It is better to give a formed stool, not a watery one.

steps: Collect the stool in a clean, dry container, not in the toilet
Make sure no urine or water gets into the sample
Use the spoon to take a piece the size of a pea or a bean
Close the container tightly and label it
Take it to the lab within the time they gave you
feel: Nothing. You collect the sample at home with no pain
Collecting it can be unpleasant, but it is quick and done only once
after: Results usually come in a few days
If elastase is low, the doctor will decide if you need enzymes or other tests

faq.q: Can I keep the sample in the fridge?
faq.a: Usually yes, for a short time. The lab will tell you exactly how long.

faq.q: Do I need a special diet before the test?
faq.a: Usually not. Eat as you always do.

reminders.text: Stool elastase test tomorrow. Get the container and a clean, dry pot or tray for collection ready.
